id: \rBefore we began, may I ask for your name?
en: \rBefore we began, may I ask for your name?
it: \rPrima di cominciare, posso chiederti il tuo nome?

id: \r\PN, is it? Well prepare to lose, \PN!
en: \r\PN, is it? Well prepare to lose, \PN!

id: \rI shall take my leave now, good luck.
en: \rI shall take my leave now, good luck.

id: \bCongratulations on winning your fourth match. \nDue to winning all four of your matches, your next battle will be on the Indigo stage.
en: \bCongratulations on winning your fourth match. \nDue to winning all four of your matches, your next battle will be on the Indigo stage.
it: \bCongratulazioni per aver vinto il tuo quarto incontro. \nAvendo vinto tutti e quattro gli incontri, la tua prossima lotta sarà sullo stadio Indaco.
